KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_METALDETECTOR: These detectors seem to be able to locate foreign objects buried in the sands around Riven Tides, though their exact way of functioning is unknown.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_POWEREDDESCENDER: Reduces fall speed when used in the air, but has a wind-up time before reaching full force. Shuts down once out of power.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_METALDETECTOR_ALT: Found around Riven Tides, these detectors seem able to locate foreign objects buried in the sands along the shore, though their exact way of functioning is unknown.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_GRAPPLEHOOK: A simple gadget that anchors to most surfaces, allowing users to navigate hard-to-reach places.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_METALDETECTOR_02: Useful for finding foreign objects hidden in the snow. As an added bonus, it works just as well on sand.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TETHERGUN: A two-shot tether launcher that anchors a line to whatever it hits, linking both points together.
